text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development, acting as a safety net for the entire team. One of their main benefits is catching bugs early, before they can cause serious problems in the final product. By having another set of eyes examine the code, developers can spot issues that the original writer may have missed, saving time and money in the long run. Beyond fixing errors, code reviews are an excellent tool for knowledge sharing. They allow team members to learn from each other’s techniques and understand different parts of the project. Ultimately, this process improves the overall quality of the codebase and strengthens the whole team.
